role: paint-job preparation and bake submission boundary
semantic_claim: The function is modeled as an ordered paint-job preparation and submission boundary. EditorSkin, model, service, and job ownership remain opaque; no profile, editor transient, or UI ownership semantics are assigned.

implementation.model: opaque editor and 0x84-byte paint job with injected boundary services

scope_guard.editor: Opaque 0x88-byte carrier for the observed editor fields; the larger live cEditor type is not promoted into this boundary.
scope_guard.paint_job: Opaque 0x84-byte carrier; Ghidra has no resolved PaintJob or cPaintJob structure for this allocation.
scope_guard.editor_skin: Opaque; live cEditorSkin is 0x88 bytes, but no field is consumed directly by 0x004c5200.
scope_guard.model: Opaque; live Model is 0x94 bytes and live EditorModel is 0xe0 bytes; no model ownership is inferred.
scope_guard.services: IBakeManager, PropertyList, paint system, and property service pointers remain opaque ports.
scope_guard.cancellation_side_effect: The injected cancellation service owns the live job+0x6b write; the boundary source does not duplicate that write.

allocation_boundary.result: The allocator/construction port returns OpaquePaintJob* directly; its pointer value is the opaque job handle stored at editor+0x5c.
allocation_boundary.resolver: No resolve_paint_job call or resolver-derived pointer is part of 0x004c5200.

observed_execution_order.fact: Read editor+0x84 and return zero without a service call when it is zero.

When a current job exists and both job+0x6b and job+0x6c are zero, check reusable state, get the paint system, cancel the job, let the cancellation service own the job+0x6b write, clear editor+0x5c, and release the old job before preparation.
Read request channel-zero record and call the resource preparation boundary with editor+0x64 and editor+0x6c before allocation.
Allocate exactly 0x84 bytes with the Editor allocator domain and invoke the observed 0x0051df40 constructor only for a non-null allocation.

After the new allocation and constructor, read editor+0x5c as the previous job. If the new handle differs, retain the new job through the dedicated opaque refcount port when non-null, store the new handle, and release the prior job. If the handles are equal, skip all three operations. Then retain editor+0x1c into job+0x08 and release the prior job source after replacement.
Copy editor resources, apply max(0x40, property 0xb8864eac), set -1, apply feature and channel flags, and copy three request channel records and arrays.

Resolve the property service root, resolve the property list, invoke the property query service, and conditionally read the 0x05e68c2e array; release the property list only after bake submission handling.
Apply model-type-specific writes at job offsets 0x1c, 0x20, and 0x24 before submission.

Get IBakeManager and call its vtable+0x64 submission slot. Rejection clears and releases the current job before releasing the property list and returns zero; acceptance releases only the property list and returns nonzero.

allocation_failure_policy.live_behavior: After allocation and construction, a null result is compared with editor+0x5c. If a prior job exists, the null handle differs, so the live body stores null and releases the prior job; if both handles are null, the same-handle branch skips the store and release. The body then unconditionally reads the null job at +0x08 while attaching editor+0x1c. This is an unsafe null dereference, not a safe false return.
allocation_failure_policy.default_model: A null allocation skips the new-job retain, replaces the current handle and releases any prior job when the handles differ, and then preserves the live job+0x08 dereference; there is no implicit allocation-failure guard.
allocation_failure_policy.explicit_model_guard: PaintJobModelOptions.guard_invalid_allocation is an injected test-only option that returns false after replacement; it is not a claim about the live function.

invalid_handle_policy.live_behavior: A non-null but invalid allocation pointer returned directly reaches the unguarded construction/field-write path; no resolver call intervenes.
invalid_handle_policy.explicit_model_guard: PaintJobModelOptions.guard_invalid_job_handle is an injected test-only false return.
invalid_handle_policy.null_bake_manager: A null IBakeManager reaches the unguarded indirect submission dereference. PaintJobModelOptions.guard_null_bake_manager is an injected test-only false return that releases the property list first.

opaque_refcount_boundary.operation: After allocation and construction, compare the new handle with editor+0x5c. When different, increment the non-null new job's opaque refcount before storing its handle, then release the previous job. When equal, skip retain, store, and release.
opaque_refcount_boundary.source_reference_retain: The later editor+0x1c attachment uses a separate source-reference retain operation.

editor.0x5c: store the new job handle and release the prior job when the new handle differs; leave the handle unchanged when they are equal
